summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported from London advices that Tom Allen wanted to fight Johnny Dwyer for the heavyweight title and challenged any man at catch weights for $1,000 a side.

facts.fact: Allen, in London, issued a challenge to fight any man in the world at catch weights for $1,000 a side, within 100 miles of Buffalo, in Canada or within fifty miles of Pittsburg
Allen was said to have fought seven times for the heavyweight championship of America
